batching.scope: One frozen model per batch; age/deadline fairness; no extra flush wait between model batches

inference.timing_note: Host elapsed time; CUDA forward kernel duration is in optional profiler traces

historical_opponents.sampling: Independent PFSP snapshot seats including IL, with the same uniform floor; IL checkpoint retained as evaluation/calibration anchor

environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

utilization.inference_model_scope: Counts, sums and histograms are per-collection deltas; queue_wait_max_seconds is since service start

inference_batching.scope: Per-collection count deltas; pending-position peak is cumulative

utilization.actor_cpu_scope: Python actor process CPU during games; includes its threads, excludes Mono children and GPU; unavailable for cached games/multiple host lanes
utilization.scope: ordinary collection; actor/inference phase times overlap; actor_python_* measures process CPU, not total machine or GPU utilization

replay_ingress.scope: Reader-task CPU excludes process startup and result serialization; worker elapsed phases overlap across readers. Wall is the final join/merge; average cores uses the full streaming interval when enabled.

gae_stage_evidence.scope: Current lambda stage, committed rolling window; retained PPG critic work from healthy iterations only; zero steps alone do not reset health

historical.extension_age_scope: Committed collections using this lambda stage; qualification at lambda=1 does not count
historical.review: Inspect common PL rating slope/uncertainty and by-table advantage std; no automatic rollback

evidence.scope: Pooled row-weighted online EV at retained post-PPG weights; same contributing iterations for self-play; distinct whole-game support, learner seats only; not current-model re-evaluation or independent confidence bounds

historical.streak_scope: Consecutive PPO/economic health and applicable value KL guard; critic work supported across the mixed-table EV window

legacy.extension_age_scope: Committed collections using this lambda stage; qualification at lambda=1 does not count
legacy.review: Inspect common PL rating slope/uncertainty and by-table advantage std; no automatic rollback

evidence.scope: Pooled row-weighted online EV at retained post-PPG weights; same contributing iterations for self-play; distinct whole-game support, learner seats only; not current-model re-evaluation or independent confidence bounds

legacy.streak_scope: Consecutive PPO/economic health and applicable value KL guard; critic work supported across the mixed-table EV window

historical.scope: Existing pooled EV admission tolerance; review signal only, no automatic rollback

legacy.scope: Existing pooled EV admission tolerance; review signal only, no automatic rollback

gate_diagnostics.scope: Existing evidence only; missing groups are unavailable, not zero EV; no automatic threshold changes

local_scoring_auxiliary.training_scope: Detached device totals transferred together at reporting; attempted presentations/loss totals include rejected intervals. Retained counts follow joint checkpoint selection.
local_scoring_auxiliary.scope: Critic-train rows only; official held-out loss and exact policy KL remain the acceptance criteria. Invalid scoring audits fail admission.

heldout.scope: At most 2048 ordinary learner critic-held-out rows balanced by era/table; branches and snapshot seats excluded. These families retain their existing PPO actor use.

strength_rating.scope: Held-out mixed-table PL model with Gaussian priors; IL theta fixed at zero; setup-cluster percentile intervals; seat-neutral outrank probabilities

alerts.v4_watch_action: Review three-slot decline; no automatic increase or rollback of the ordinary v4 share
alerts.deployment_status: Pending separate panel review; no automatic publication
